summary: acer aspire 7 gaming laptop experiencing thermal throttling issues with temperatures reaching up to 93\u00b0C during intense gaming sessions. The laptop performs well in normal browsing but struggles with unlocked FPS gaming.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to inadequate cooling system, likely caused by insufficient thermal paste or poor air circulation.
suggested_solution: Apply a high-quality thermal paste and ensure proper air circulation around the laptop by lifting its back feet. Additionally, consider undervolting the CPU to reduce temperatures.
